findings.suggestion: Rebase onto current dev; insert `filterProjectionsByReadVisibility(pool, tenantId, projections, grants, ancestry, nowMs)` (dev/T-0722) BEFORE `.map(projectionToInstance)`/`selectProcessPage`, so `total` = |PDP-visible ∩ query-match| (post-PDP).
